dogecoin.text: Wait a little bit until the Dogecoin changes into wDOGE. You will see it in your wallet when it’s ready! #6

Step 4: Change DOGE Coins to Dogechain Coins
• Use your Dogecoin to get Dogechain Coins (wDOGE). Click on “Bridge” and follow the steps to turn your DOGE into wDOGE, which is like Dogecoin but works on Dogechain. #5

Step 2: Get Some DOGE Coins with Credit Card
• Ask an adult to help you buy Dogecoin. You can buy it from a big website called an “exchange” (like Coinbase or Binance).
• Put the Dogecoin in  wallet. Once you get Dogecoin, send it to your wallet on MetaMask  #3
